🚀 proxelar | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Debugging and manipulating local HTTP, HTTPS, and WebSocket traffic for API development, application testing, and network analysis.
✨ Key Features: • Scriptable traffic manipulation with Lua • Interactive request interception and editing • HTTPS Man-in-the-Middle with local CA generation • Multiple interfaces: TUI, Web GUI, REST API, CLI • Support for HTTP/1, HTTP/2, and feature-gated HTTP/3
📖 Summary: Proxelar is a Rust-based MITM proxy designed for developers to inspect, intercept, rewrite, and replay HTTP, HTTPS, and WebSocket traffic locally. It offers multiple interfaces including a TUI, a web GUI, and a REST API, along with powerful Lua scripting capabilities for traffic manipulation.
